requirements.description: A 53-card joker deck deals seven player cards set into a five-card high hand and a two-card low hand against a house-way dealer, where the low hand may never outrank the high hand, copies go to the dealer, winning both hands pays even money minus a five percent commission, and the semi-wild joker completes straights and flushes and otherwise plays as an ace.
requirements.notes: Issue #73 allocates the permanent distinct rules requirement for issue #138.

requirements.description: Authenticated sessions own private reload-safe setting rounds, hidden dealer cards until showdown, durable action receipts, bounded settled history, and canonical route restoration.
requirements.notes: Session context overrides caller player ids, dealer cards remain hidden until settlement, and committed results survive reload and process restart.

requirements.description: The ante debit and the returned-token settlement credit use the shared ledger exactly once under durable action identities, while losing rounds add no token movement.
requirements.notes: No game code mutates balances directly and conflicting retries fail closed.

requirements.description: Pai Gow Poker supplies complete English and Russian responsive, accessible, reduced-motion-safe, timer-clean play.
requirements.notes: Evidence covers both locales, every governed viewport, all seven visual states, and fail-closed fixed-feedback non-occlusion geometry, including the desktop-primary Russian settled-history clearance.

requirements.description: Catalog, contract, browser, and long-suite discovery include Pai Gow Poker with requirement, module, version, and visual traceability.
requirements.notes: Descriptor sort order 310 and the catalog-discovered long driver are canonical.

requirements.description: The dealer house way balances toward the strongest legal two-card hand with the five-card hand as tiebreak, so the mirrored maximize-low strategy nets negative for the player under the five percent commission.
requirements.notes: The prior objective maximized the five-card hand absolutely and was measured exploitable for about a twenty-four percent player edge; the seeded Monte Carlo evidence asserts the sign inversion directly.

requirements.description: Pai Gow Poker publishes deal preparation, action receipts, player sets, revealed dealer house-way cards, ledger proof, terminal archive, settlement recovery, and action-owned rollback through provider-current callbacks that replace only active round, recent rounds, and action receipts. Competing processes preserve unrelated player-state siblings and fail closed before stale sets can overwrite or resurrect a terminal hand, while lost ledger responses reconcile immutable proof without repeating a debit or credit.
requirements.notes: The frozen v1 routes, cards, house way, paytable, dealer privacy, and ledger vocabulary remain unchanged. Production multiworker activation stays blocked because state, ledger, and history remain separate transaction boundaries.
